result.edit: The test fails at cycle=3 with gray code 0010 when expecting 0011. The issue is in the Gray-to-binary conversion where intermediate values are computed using blocking assignments (=) instead of non-blocking (<=). This causes incorrect propagation of values within the same clock cycle. Changing to non-blocking assignments and using direct XOR operations between gray_wire bits ensures correct binary conversion, which will then properly increment and convert back to the expected Gray code sequence.
